data.title: 🐣 Gem of the week: Marcel Reguła 🇵🇱 - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # 🐣 Gem of the week: Marcel Reguła 🇵🇱. Today, we're showcasing a Polish playmaker who'll soon be joining a club in one of Europe's top five leagues — you heard it here first! At just 20, Marcel Reguła is reaching new heights with Zagłębie Lubin, the club where he came through the ranks. The 2025–2026 season had already seen Marcel Reguła make a name for himself. His performances caught the attention of Burnley and Borussia Dortmund in particular, with moves to both clubs coming close to materialising this summer. In 14 appearances this season, he has already scored five goals and provided one assist. His performances have also earned him a place in the Polish national team. Selected again for the November international break, he prepared perfectly for his return to the national side by scoring twice this weekend. A moment that perfectly captures the talent and elegance of a player who could well become the next face of Polish football.

data.title: Roma creating 145% more chances compared to 2025/26 - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Roma creating 145% more chances compared to 2025/26. Roma has become increasingly Gasperini-esque at the start of this season, game after game. The Giallorossi team has become a reflection of the coach's approach to football in every match, regardless of the opponent. The Roman side has already scored 19 more goals than a year ago at this point in the season: from 12, they've increased their attacking turnover to 31, averaging 3.37 goals per win. Roma's attacking play has improved significantly compared to a year ago. As Corriere dello Sport reports, shots on target increased from 57 to 72, touches in the final 16 meters increased from 267 to 409, and successful dribbles nearly doubled (from 60 to 102). The Giallorossi are proving more effective with and without the ball: they've already recovered 13 more balls in the opposition's half (from 47 to 60), although the most impressive statistic is the 145% increase in the number of great chances created (from 20 after 11 matchdays, now 49).

data.title: Glovo and PragmaGO Bring Embedded Lending to Polish Merchants - The Fintech Times
data.content: * Glovo and PragmaGO Bring Embedded Lending to Polish Merchants. #### ***Glovo** and **PragmaGO** have extended their embedded lending partnership to Poland, making PragmaCash financing available to the delivery platform’s network of local merchants from October 2026. Poland is the third market for the tie-up, following rollouts in Spain and Romania.*. Running a local business now requires the capacity to act quickly on market opportunities, she said, and access to capital through the platform itself reduces friction for merchants already operating inside the Glovo ecosystem. The model is structurally attractive: a platform that processes a merchant’s transaction data already holds the most reliable proxy for repayment capacity, making underwriting faster and cheaper than a traditional bank loan application. PragmaGO’s positioning is notable in that it is not a pure-play technology intermediary but a regulated financial institution with three decades of SME lending experience in Poland, operating since 1996.
